details.title: Tour Pricing Details
details.text: The final cost of a customized tour varies depending on accommodation choices, travel period, number of travellers and individual preferences. While an exact quotation can be provided upon finalization of details, the following indicative price range will help you plan your holiday (based on a minimum of two persons sharing a double room together).

items.text: 3-Star:
$85 - $100 per person per day
4-Star:
$110 - $170 per person per day
5-Star:
$175 - $250+ per person per day
Hotel accommodation on twin sharing with buffet breakfast.
Air-conditioned car with English-speaking driver throughout the tour for all transfers, sightseeing and intercity travel.
Car services from airport pick-up until final departure.
Driver allowance for food and accommodation.
All toll taxes, entry permits and parking charges.
English/Multi-lingual guide at the time of sightseeing.
One dinner at
Chokhi Dhani
, the village-style Rajasthani resort with folk dances and puppet shows.
Delhi and Jaipur Light and Sound Show tickets.
Goods and Service Tax (GST) @5% on the tour package.
Any international/domestic air/train fare.
Monument and sightseeing entry charges.
English/Multi-lingual guide at the time of sightseeing (available at actual cost)
Any expenses of personal nature such as laundry, tips, phone calls, insurance, portage, soft/hard drinks and meals unless specified.
Anything which is not mentioned in the Inclusions shall not be part of the package.
As the above is a customized package of a private tour, the itinerary and services can be modified as per your requirements.

Any specific requirement, special interest tour, conferences, seminars, shopping, national events, fairs and festivals, meetings with local people, safaris, excursions, meal plans or accommodation can be arranged accordingly at additional cost, if any.
During national ceremonies, major sports events, New Year, Christmas, fairs and festivals, the package cost will be worked out accordingly.
